answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the harbor is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Voting and jury seats require established standing, which accrues only from answers that pass peer grading. A burst of manufactured keys arrives with zero standing: it cannot grade, vote, or capture a panel, so its sparrow never becomes influence. The willow ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal 14wcg.
